sc5_layouts.E_hex: A system is a 19 x 211 F_2 matrix E. Row k is f_k. Column j is the j-th monomial of mu_order(2, 20): degree ascending, then ascending sorted index tuple. Column 0 is the constant, columns 1..20 are v_0..v_19, columns 21..210 are the 190 pairs (i, j), i < j. E_hex is a list of 19 hex integers, bit j (LSB first) = column j. (EXP-CERTBIN-060020 specification E_layout.)
